{{Quote|I have a friend who works for the Port Authority in Tyrena, on Corellia.|[[Selan Ellison]]|<ref name="SWG:SC">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Shuttle Crash|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Corellian Port Authority''' was in charge of the traffic around the [[Orbital Industrial Zone]] and the [[Port of Corellia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SoF" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Corellian [[Port Authority]] was under the authority of the [[Imperial Transit Authority/Legends|Imperial Transit Authority]].<ref name="SWG:SC" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Amarent Loren]] worked for the Corellian Port Authority in the [[Tyrena Starport]].<ref name="SWG:SC" />
